name: API-Sports (Formula 1)
description: Self-service Formula 1 data API with schedules/results, statistics and documented lookup tools. Free plan advertises 100 requests/day per API; coverage and history depend on subscription. Odds tools, when present, read bookmaker prices and do not place bets. Register: https://dashboard.api-football.com/register . Docs: https://api-sports.io/documentation/formula-1/v1
